## PRB1.1. IFR movements {#prb1.1.-ifr-movements .Heading-2-ER}

- The Union-wide level recorded 9,987K actual IFR movements in 2025, +4.2% compared to 2024 (9,587K).

- Actual 2025 IFR movements were in line with the STATFOR October 2024 base forecast (9,954K).

- Actual 2025 IFR movements were in line with the actual 2019 level (9,985K).

- In 2025, Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine continued to significantly affect traffic flows within the SES area. In addition, the geopolitical situation in the Middle East also influenced traffic patterns. As a result, some ANSPs experienced unexpectedly strong traffic growth compared with the Union-wide average, while others had yet to recover to the 2019 traffic levels.
